notes: Μετὰ τὸ γενέσθαι με ἐκεῖ is analysed under rule 61: the preposition takes 'After', the article is unrepresented, and the infinitive keeps its own English.
ὅτι is recitative and unrepresented under rule 43, the ASV marking the speech by punctuation alone.
The two accusative subjects (s024, s027) are expressed in the Greek and each takes its own 'I'; rule 74 concerns a supplied subject and is cited only for the placement.
